Tribute to welfare walks
Travel season has been kind to the desk
Steady care, clear notes, and calm handoffs have kept our Companion Animal Travel Desk in step with each journey. Staff have continued to review comfort needs with care, while supervisors listen closely and guide each concern through a calm, stepwise process. The result has been smoother arrivals, cleaner planning, and more reassurance for travelers and their companions.

Our team is grateful for the thoughtful cooperation shown across Aurelia Skyways, from the welfare coordinator's steady oversight to the patient support offered at the counter and gate. <<FACT F017>><<FACT F001>> These small acts of attention help pets settle well, and they help our colleagues uphold a reassuring standard day after day. Companion Animal Travel Desk
